title: Air quality
setup.subtitle: Set up Aranet4
setup.dependencies: Install the Bluetooth support for Aranet4. You only need to do this once.
setup.discovery: Enable Smart Home integrations in the Aranet Home app, close the app, and keep your monitor nearby.
setup.noneFound: No Aranet4 monitors found. Keep your monitor nearby with Smart Home integrations enabled, then scan again.
setup.enableIntegrations: For dimmed monitors, enable Smart Home integrations in the Aranet Home app, close the app, and scan again.
